symptom: report map flags a module that only publishes a REST feed as an integration module, and misses the app's real integration ports (Int_HR, Int_Planning) because they run on mock adapters with no client yet
cause: the integration flag was any integration artefact count (mappings, JSON structures, published and consumed services), and nothing else
insight: Direction matters: outbound clients make a port, a published API does not. Ports are built against mocks long before the real connection exists, so name and documentation conventions — and an annotation override — are needed to find them early. Saying why each was flagged makes a wrong convention visible
